description: Acquisition and update-check contracts for locally maintained CSV KPI sources. The checker never downloads or replaces these files.

environmental_performance_index.notes: A newer release is a notification only. Review the official EPI.new column, country coverage, methodology and CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 reuse terms before replacing the snapshot. Do not combine editions in a time series.

global_peace_index.notes: The public report and the reusable country dataset may have different access conditions.

lpi_infrastructure.notes: The survey-based infrastructure score ends in 2023. LPI 2.0 is methodologically different and must not be appended.

network_readiness_index.notes: A stable official complete-dataset URL has to be verified manually before changing acquisition.

olympic_medals_summer.notes: Edition totals are reviewed before entry. The CSV adapter automatically applies Olympic-specific delegation rules and current UN membership before publishing.

olympic_medals_winter.notes: Edition totals are reviewed before entry. The CSV adapter automatically applies Olympic-specific delegation rules and current UN membership before publishing.

pisa_overall_score.notes: Review the official Annex B1 mean-score tables for reading, mathematics and science. Rebuild the series with the same three-domain formula and review sampling flags and participant geography before import.

recycling_rate.notes: Keep manual until the exact OECD waste measure is contractually matched to the existing KPI definition.

social_progress_index.notes: Do not automate login, scrape gated downloads or bypass dataset terms.

world_happiness_index.notes: Notification only; preserve the report-edition and three-year-average semantics during manual import.
